title: Bosch Green-Beam Self-Leveling Cross-Line Laser
description:
Bosch GLL50-20GL Green-Beam Self-Leveling Cross-Line Laser Level

The Bosch GLL50-20GL Green-Beam Self-Leveling Cross-Line Laser Level provides bright, accurate horizontal and vertical reference lines for professional leveling, alignment, and layout applications. Ideal for drywall installation, framing, interior finishing, and general construction, this compact laser projects two highly visible green beams that are up to 4x brighter than standard red beams.

The GLL50-20GL provides a working range of up to 65 ft. with an accuracy of ±1/4" at 30 ft. Built-in VisiMax technology monitors operating conditions and power consumption to optimize laser line visibility, battery runtime, and long-term tool performance.

Flexible power options help minimize downtime on the job. The Bosch GLL50-20GL can operate using the included 3.7V Lithium-Ion 1.0 Ah battery, which allows the laser to be used while charging, or two AA batteries (sold separately). This dual-power design provides a convenient backup power option for demanding jobsites.

The Smart Pendulum System automatically self-levels and alerts the user to out-of-level conditions by blinking the laser lines. When switched off, the pendulum locks securely in place to help protect the leveling mechanism during transportation and storage. The laser can also be intentionally tilted to project angled lines for applications that do not require a level or plumb reference.

Designed for everyday professional use, the GLL50-20GL features a compact, lightweight housing with a full rubber overmold that helps protect major impact points. Its IP55-rated construction provides dust and water resistance for dependable performance in demanding jobsite conditions.

An integrated magnetic mount provides quick and convenient positioning on compatible metal surfaces, while the standard 1/4"-20 threaded mount allows the laser to be used with compatible tripods and mounting accessories.

title: Bosch HEPA Filter
description:
Bosch VF130H Long-Life HEPA Filter for VAC090 & VAC140 Dust Extractors

The Bosch VF130H Long-Life HEPA Filter is designed for compatible Bosch VAC090- and VAC140-Series Dust Extractors, providing high-efficiency filtration for professional dust collection applications. The HEPA filter captures 99.97% of particles at 0.3 microns and larger, helping control fine dust generated during drywall, concrete, construction, and surface preparation applications.

Designed for use with compatible Bosch dust extractors featuring automatic filter cleaning, the VF130H has an enhanced low-stick filter surface that helps improve the automatic filter-cleaning process and maintain efficient airflow during demanding dust collection applications.

The Bosch VF130H HEPA Filter is an important component of the Bosch PRO+GUARD Dust Solution System. When used with the appropriate Bosch dust extractor, power tool, accessory, attachment, connections, and required personal protective equipment, the system is designed to help users move toward compliance with applicable OSHA respirable crystalline silica dust requirements.

For improved filter protection and airflow, Bosch recommends using a compatible fleece filter bag with the VF130H. A fleece bag helps prevent abrasive materials and sharp debris from coming into direct contact with the HEPA filter while also helping maintain efficient dust collection performance.

Important: The Bosch VF130H is designed for dry vacuuming applications only. Using this HEPA filter for wet vacuuming may damage the filter. For wet-vacuum applications, use the appropriate Bosch filter, such as the VF110 Polyester Filter.

Bosch VF130H HEPA Filter Features:

  • Long-life HEPA filter Ð Provides high-efficiency filtration for compatible Bosch professional dust extractors.
  • 99.97% filtration efficiency Ð Captures 99.97% of particles at 0.3 microns and larger.
  • Enhanced low-stick surface Ð Helps improve the automatic filter-cleaning process and maintain efficient airflow.
  • Bosch PRO+GUARD Dust Solution System Ð Provides HEPA filtration as part of Bosch's end-to-end professional dust-control system.
  • Fleece filter bag recommended Ð Using a compatible fleece bag helps protect the HEPA filter from abrasive materials and sharp debris while maintaining airflow.
  • Compatible with Bosch VAC090-Series Ð Designed for use with compatible Bosch 9-gallon dust extractors.
  • Compatible with Bosch VAC140-Series Ð Works with compatible Bosch 14-gallon dust extractors.
  • Dry vacuuming only Ð Designed exclusively for dry dust collection and should not be used for wet-vacuum applications.
  • Professional dust collection Ð Ideal for drywall, concrete, construction, and other dust-producing applications when used with a compatible Bosch dust extraction system.

title: Bosch 9 Gallon Fleece Dust Bags (5pk)
description:
Bosch VB090F Fleece Filter Bags for 9-Gallon Dust Extractors

The Bosch VB090F Fleece Filter Bags are replacement dust collection bags designed for compatible Bosch 9-gallon dust extractors, including the VAC090A and VAC090S. These fleece dust bags provide an efficient and convenient way to collect and dispose of dry dust, debris, and other vacuumed materials while helping protect the dust extractor's main filter.

Each Bosch dust extractor filter bag acts as a primary pre-filter by capturing larger debris before it reaches the main filter, helping extend filter life and maintain efficient dust collection. The fleece construction provides reliable containment of dry materials for professional construction, drywall, concrete, and general jobsite cleanup applications.

For cleaner and easier disposal, each Bosch VB090F filter bag includes a port cover that securely closes the bag opening after removal. This helps keep captured dust and debris contained inside the bag during handling and disposal.

The Bosch VB090F fleece filter bags are compatible with select Bosch VAC090-Series and VAC140-Series Dust Extractors. They are designed exclusively for dry vacuuming applications and should not be used for wet pickup.

Important: The Bosch VB090F is designed for dry vacuuming only. Wet vacuuming can damage the fleece filter bag. For wet-vacuum applications, use the appropriate Bosch wet-vac filter, such as the VF110 Polyester Filter.

title: Bosch 5-3/8" 30 Tooth Edge Circular Saw Blade
description:
Bosch Edge Carbide Ferrous Metal-Cutting Circular Saw Blade

The Bosch Edge Ferrous Metal-Cutting Saw Blade is engineered for fast, clean, and accurate cutting of tough ferrous metals. Designed for professional metalworking, construction, and steel framing applications, this carbide metal-cutting circular saw blade delivers long-lasting cutting performance through mild steel plate, steel studs, angle iron, bar stock, pipe, and other ferrous metal materials.

Bosch Brute Carbide uses an extra-hard C6 micrograin carbide formulation engineered for increased impact resistance and extended blade life. The blade's Half-Bevel Grind (HBG) tooth geometry provides maximum cutting performance and a high-quality finish when working with tough and abrasive ferrous metals.

A reduced positive hook angle produces fast, clean cuts with minimal burrs, helping reduce the amount of finishing required after cutting. Bosch SpeedCoat provides an anti-friction finish for cooler operation and less dust compared to bonded abrasive cutting wheels.

Built for demanding professional applications, the extra-hard steel blade body provides accurate cutting while resisting bending and deflection. Integrated expansion slots help reduce the risk of blade warping, while body slots help manage excessive heat during cutting. Control-cut shoulders are incorporated into the blade design to help reduce kickback.

Whether cutting steel studs, metal framing, mild steel, angle iron, bar stock, or pipe, Bosch Edge Ferrous Metal-Cutting Saw Blades provide the durability, accuracy, and cutting performance needed for demanding professional applications.

  • Brute Carbide Ð Extra-hard C6 micrograin carbide formulation provides increased impact resistance and long blade life.
  • Half-Bevel Grind (HBG) tooth geometry Ð Designed for high cutting performance and a quality finish in tough, abrasive metals.

title: Bosch 9 Gallon HEPA Vac with Auto Filter Clean
description:
Bosch VAC090AH 9-Gallon HEPA Dust Extractor with Auto Filter Clean

The Bosch VAC090AH 9-Gallon HEPA Dust Extractor delivers powerful dust collection for professional drywall, concrete, construction, and surface preparation applications. title: Bosch Drywall Sander Kit
description:
Bosch GTR55-85 9" Electric Drywall Sander for Walls & Ceilings

The Bosch GTR55-85 9" Drywall Sander is designed to make sanding drywall mud, joint compound, plaster, and other surface preparation applications faster, easier, and more comfortable. Built for professional drywall finishing, this electric drywall sander combines an ultra-flexible sanding head, adjustable suction modes, ergonomic controls, and a quick-release extension pole for efficient sanding of both walls and ceilings.

Bosch's exclusive Ultra-Flexible Head conforms to the work surface for smooth, controlled sanding while helping reduce the risk of surface damage. The flexible head allows the drywall sanding disc to move more effortlessly across walls and ceilings, making it easier to achieve a consistent finish over large surface areas.

The GTR55-85 features separate wall-sanding and ceiling-suction modes. When sanding overhead, the ceiling-suction mode uses suction to help support the weight of the drywall sander against the ceiling, reducing strain and fatigue during extended overhead sanding applications. The ergonomic T-handle grip provides multiple gripping positions for greater comfort and control when sanding walls or ceilings.

A quick-release extension pole allows users to quickly adjust the sander for different applications. The extension can be removed when sanding walls or working at lower heights, eliminating unnecessary pole weight compared to a fixed telescoping design.

Convenient, easy-to-reach controls allow users to adjust power, RPM, and airflow without removing their hand from the grip. When connected to a compatible dust extractor or vacuum, the Bosch GTR55-85 provides an efficient drywall sanding and dust collection system for professional drywall finishing and surface preparation.

  • Professional 9" drywall sander Ð Designed for fast, efficient sanding of drywall mud, joint compound, plaster, and other surface preparation applications.

title: Columbia Mud Roller Washer
description:
Columbia Mud Roller Washer


The Columbia Mud Roller Washer makes cleaning Columbia Mud Compound Rollers faster and easier after drywall finishing and skim-coating applications. Designed to remove wet joint compound from the roller fibers, this convenient cleaning tool helps reduce manual scrubbing and keeps mud rollers ready for the next job.


The washer connects to any standard drill, allowing the drill to rotate the mud roller during cleaning. This powered spinning action helps loosen and remove compound buildup throughout the roller cover for a more thorough and efficient cleanup.


Regular cleaning can help preserve roller performance, maintain consistent compound application, and extend the usable life of Columbia mud roller replacements. Compact and easy to operate, the Columbia Mud Roller Washer is a practical maintenance accessory for professional drywall contractors, painters, remodelers, and finishing crews.


Features:


  • Designed for cleaning Columbia Mud Compound Rollers
  • Connects to any standard drill
  • Uses powered rotation to simplify roller cleaning
  • Helps remove wet joint compound from roller fibers
  • Reduces time spent manually scrubbing mud rollers
  • Provides a faster and more thorough cleaning process
  • Helps prevent compound buildup within the roller cover
  • Supports consistent mud pickup and application
  • Helps extend the working life of mud roller replacements
  • Suitable for Columbia mud rollers in multiple sizes

title: AMES ColorVis Joint Compound Additive - Yellow
description:
AMES ColorVis Joint Compound Additive - Yellow


Add AMES ColorVis Coloring Gel to joint compound for identification of 1st / 2nd / Final coats and touch ups!
Directions: Add 1/4 oz. (approximately 1.5 teaspoons) of ColorVis™, per gallon of joint compound* and mix well. Allow compound to dry completely before sanding or applying paint. Use different colors to differentiate coats.


Warning: Always wear proper eye protection and dust mask when mixing, applying, or sanding joint compound. Flush with water in case of eye contact. Contact physician if ingested.


Key Features:

  • Reduces Sanding & Dust
  • Helps Eliminate Flashing
  • Won’t Show Through Paint
  • Reduces Call Backs
  • Ideal for Tracking Overall Job Progress
  • Perfect for Punchlist Touch Ups

Lightweight and portable, the GROOVE-90 delivers the performance of a stationary machine. It can cut multiple kerfs to create radius profiles or even round columns from gypsum or plywood. Additionally, it can carve rectangular grooves to inlay stylish, functional LED lighting strips for high-end accents.


Features:


  • MULTIPLE PROFILES – Quickly and precisely cut V-Grooves, rectangular grooves and multiple Kerfs to create radius shapes
  • CUTS V-GROOVES – form perfect 90° or 45° corners without the need for corner bead, joint compound, or joint tape.
  • CUTS RECTANGULAR GROOVES – cuts grooves between 15-25mm wide, ideal for installing LED strip lights flush with the surrounding surface. The guiderails cut lengths up to 12-ft.
  • CUTS MULTIPLE KERFS SIMULTANEOUSLY – make up to four cuts in a single pass, ideal for creating perfect radius profiles in drywall, solid wood, or plywood.
  • CUTS CHAMFERS – easily cut clean chamfers in multiple materials
  • PRECISE ADJUSTMENT - The milling depth can be adjusted to the nearest millimeter on a scale of 1/10 using the fine-tuning set screw.
  • PROFESSIONAL – the professional aluminum guide rail system provides precise positioning and stable, repeatable cuts.
  • PRECISION - the milling plate runs along the material surface, which prevents tipping and provides the GROOVE-90 with a secure position even when used in conjunction with a guide rail.
  • CONVENIENT – Quickly and easily remove the protective cover to change blades.
  • ECONOMICAL – the proprietary cutter blades can be rotated to provide 3X the life.
  • SAFE - The power-on lock and blade lock are both activated automatically when you open the protective cover.

title: Trim-Tex Black Widow Web Spinner Pole Sander
description:
Trim-Tex Black Widow Web Spinner Pole Sander - 580P

The Trim-Tex Black Widow Web Spinner 580P is the industry’s lightest 9" radial sanding head—engineered to reduce fatigue, improve control, and deliver consistently smooth drywall finishes. Manufactured in the USA with high-strength poly-resin, it’s up to three times lighter than competing tools, allowing crews to work longer with less strain and greater precision. Designed with a true 90° swivel, the sanding head sits perfectly flat against the surface, helping users maintain a natural wrist position while reaching high, low, and tight spaces with ease. Even pressure across the entire pad means cleaner results with fewer passes and less rework.

The integrated Aplix® Intermold® hook system provides a perfectly flat sanding surface and superior disc adhesion. Unlike hand-assembled Velcro® systems that wear out, shift, or create bumps, Aplix® is molded directly into the tool—offering stronger hold, longer lifespan, and more consistent sanding from start to finish.

Built without unnecessary rubber “anti-gouge” gimmicks, the Black Widow Web Spinner relies on true balance, light weight, and precision—not false protection rings that still leave marks. The no-flip body stays stable when leaned or set down, preventing damage to the tool or the wall and keeping workflow frustration-free.

Proudly made in the USA, this sander delivers high-quality performance, dependable durability, and the consistency professionals demand.

Sanding Pads Sold Separately.

title: TapeTech 48" Dual Serrated Edge Magnesium Darby with Knob & Rail
description:
TapeTech 48" Dual Serrated Edge Magnesium Darby with Knob & Rail - EMAGDARBY48-SER

TapeTech darbies quickly and efficiently smooth and compact plaster and stucco surfaces. TapeTech offers a smooth darby and a serrated darby. Both tools effectively knock down high spots in the material and fill low spots. The smooth darby helps to smooth and seal the plaster or stucco surface while the serrated darby creates small grooves in the surface. These grooves essentially “key” the surface to improve the adhesion of the next coat of material and introduce air to the material which accelerates the drying process.

Key Features:

  • Compacts plaster and stucco: Compresses the material to eliminate voids and improve adhesion.
  • Smooths and levels plaster and stucco: The long, flat blade of the darby sweeps across the wet plaster or stucco material to make it level.
  • Eliminates high spots: The darby shaves down any high spots in the plaster or stucco, leaving a flat surface.
  • Fills low spots: Use the darby to move extra material to low spots to achieve a consistent, uniform surface.
  • Improves adhesion: The serrated edge darby creates a textured surface that gives the next coat of material a better "key" or grip.
  • Accelerates drying time: The serrations allow air to circulate, which helps the material dry faster, especially in cooler or more humid conditions. This allows you to get to the next coat sooner.
  • Ergonomic Design: Ergonomic design features one knob and one handle for comfortable, all-day use and maneuverability.

title: AMES 8" Horsehair Stipple/Texture Brush
description:
AMES 8" Horsehair Stipple/Texture Brush - ATEXBRUSH08

The AMES Stipple Brush is ideal for matching a stipple pattern on an existing surface or for adding texture to new surfaces. It makes quick work of professional texture finishes or covering and hiding minor imperfections. 
The AMES Stipple Brush quickly attaches to any handle with a standard Acme thread, including standard painter's poles. The design and texture level can be customized by chanoeig the amount of compound, pressure applied, or spacing crone imprint.


 

Key Features:

  • Pre-Cut
  • Pre-Formed
  • Geometrically Designed
  • Polypropylene block with a horse hair/poly fill


 

To achieve professional results:

  1.  Add a small amount of water to the joint compound and mix thoroughly, testing in a small area to achieve desired consistency. You may need to experiment witletnew mixes when trying to match an existing texture.
  2.  ﻿Use a roller to apply the compound in an even coat by rolling the surface twice, in different directions.
  3.  ﻿Condition the Stipple Brush before use by applying a light coat of compound to the brush before beginning, then pressing it against the ceiling until the texture or pattern is uniform. With consistent pressure and positioning, press or bump into the coated surface to create the desired pattern.

title: OJO Hinge Mag 4.5" (Box Of 50)

The OJO HingeMag OHM45 4.5" Magnetic Door Hinge Covers offer professional painters and contractors a fast, reusable solution for masking and protecting larger door hinges during painting. Designed for 4.5-inch hinges commonly used on commercial and industrial doors, these magnetic hinge masks attach directly over compatible metal hinges to help protect hinge hardware from paint, overspray, and splatter without individually masking each hinge with tape or removing the door. Ideal for commercial painting contractors, facility maintenance teams, property managers, remodelers, and other professional painters, HingeMag helps reduce paint-preparation and cleanup time on projects with multiple doors. The OHM45 can be used during brush, roller, or spray painting applications and can be easily removed and reused after painting, providing an efficient hinge-masking solution for commercial, industrial, institutional, and multi-unit painting projects.


Features:

  • Keep doors on while painting with 4.5" hinge masking magnets - no more masking door hinges and removing tape, perfect for residential painting and trimming.
  • Easy application - place one over each hinge to get painting and trimming in seconds then remove when done and re-use as needed.
  • Works great as mask for brush, roll, or spray painting. Plastic sheeting connects the magnets to cover the hinge cylinder front and back.
  • 4.5" model is ideal for industrial/commercial door hinges, check out the 3.5" version for residential door hinges.
  • Box of 50 disposable or re-usable residential magnetic door hinge masks.

title: Columbia Sabre Smoothing Blade Set

title: TapeTech 18V Cordless EIFS Sanding Pack
description:
TapeTech 18V Cordless EIFS Sanding Pack

The TapeTech 18V Dual Disc Sander and 18V Cordless Brushless Backpack Vacuum deliver unmatched mobility, power, and efficiency for EIFS, drywall, and foam panel applications. Designed for professionals who need cordless convenience and dust-free performance, this system is perfect for working on scaffolding or in tight spaces.

The 18V Dual Disc Sander quickly sands EPS, XPS, and other materials, saving time and effort on the jobsite. Its 8" contra-rotating dual disc design ensures smooth operation and perfect balance. The independent motor mounts on your belt, reducing the in-hand weight of the sander to just 5 pounds. The brushless motor features electronic soft-start and overload protection for longer tool life and low maintenance. Continuous speed control maintains consistent RPM, even under load.

The wide sanding surface creates a more uniform finish compared to standard hand rasps. Powered by two 5.0 Ah batteries, the sander can cover up to 950 square feet on a single charge. A TapeTech battery adapter (sold separately) allows you to use Bosch, Makita, Milwaukee, or DeWalt batteries—keeping you powered all day long. The integrated exhaust outlet connects easily to the TapeTech EIFSVAC18V Backpack Vacuum or other compatible vacuums to maintain a clean, dust-free workspace.

The TapeTech 18V Cordless Brushless Backpack Vacuum is the ideal companion to the Dual Disc Sander, offering powerful dust collection with no cords to manage. Its 3.7-gallon capacity and 7.4 gallons-per-second max airflow make it effective and comfortable for extended use. Weighing just 14 pounds, the vacuum is worn like a backpack, allowing maximum mobility and performance on scaffolding or large job sites.

Use the included batteries and quick charger or your own preferred battery brand with the TapeTech adapter system. This combo delivers the only truly cordless, dustless drywall hand sanding solution available today.

title: Mirka ABRANET® 9" Grip 240 Grit 10pk
description:
Mirka ABRANET® 9" Grip 240 Grit 10pk 9A-223-240RP

Abranet is a multifunctional and classic abrasive, specially developed for dust-free sanding across a wide range of materials, including drywall. It offers high performance and a longer lifespan than traditional abrasives, making it a cost-effective solution. The 9” versions are designed for wall and ceiling sanding with the Mirka LEROS, a long-handled random orbital sander. Dust-free sanding ensures a cleaner work environment and a superior surface finish.

Recommended for sanding a wide variety of materials, including steel, mild steel/carbon steel, stainless steel, cast iron, copper alloys (brass and bronze), non-ferrous metals, and various types of wood such as birch, beech, oak, ash, pine, teak, mahogany, hardwood, and soft or resinous wood. The Arrow HT50-4 Chromed Steel Hammer Tacker Stapler is a professional-grade fastening tool that has been trusted by contractors since the 1950s. Built for durability and speed, this heavy-duty hammer tacker features hardened steel components housed in a rugged chromed-steel body for long-lasting performance on demanding job sites. Each internal steel component is hardened in a 1,500-degree furnace to withstand repeated high-impact use. Designed with a textured, high-impact Sure-Grip handle, the HT50-4 delivers comfort, control, and consistent staple penetration with every swing.


Ideal for drywall and construction professionals, this hammer tacker is perfect for:


  • Housewrap installation
  • Insulation installation
  • Roofing underlayment
  • Flooring underlayment
  • Vapor barriers
  • General construction fastening

Whether you're securing house wrap before siding, fastening insulation batts, or installing roofing felt, the Arrow HT50-4 provides the speed and durability required for professional drywall and construction applications.


Key Features:


  • Ready for Rapid Action
    The hammer-style design allows for fast, repetitive stapling without the need for precise placement—ideal for large surface applications such as insulation, roofing, and housewrap.
  • Efficient Rear-Load Magazine

title: AMES GROOVE-90 Pro Kit
description:
AMES GROOVE-90 Pro Kit - GRV90-PROVAC

The GROOVE-90, distributed exclusively by AMES, is the ultimate portable milling machine for gypsum drywall panels, MDF, plywood, solid wood, aluminum, and more. This German-engineered multi-cutter system precisely cuts V-grooves, allowing drywall contractors to quickly form outside corners, soffits, column wraps, and other structures—without the need for corner bead, joint compound, or joint tape. The result is a flawless corner that won’t crack.

Lightweight and portable, the GROOVE-90 delivers the performance of a stationary machine. It can cut multiple kerfs to create radius profiles or even round columns from gypsum or plywood. Additionally, it can carve rectangular grooves to inlay stylish, functional LED lighting strips for high-end accents.

A step above the starter kit, the GROOVE-90 Pro Kit includes the 1000W Electric Hot Glue Gun (GRV-1000EG), a 25-lb box of Hot Glue Sticks (GRV-2515), and a Bosch 14-Gallon Dust Extractor with Auto Filter Clean and a HEPA Filter (VAC140AH).


 

Features:

  • MULTIPLE PROFILES – Quickly and precisely cut V-Grooves, rectangular grooves and multiple Kerfs to create radius shapes
  • CUTS V-GROOVES – form perfect 90° or 45° corners without the need for corner bead, joint compound, or joint tape.
  • CUTS RECTANGULAR GROOVES – cuts grooves between 15-25mm wide, ideal for installing LED strip lights flush with the surrounding surface. you may extend the guiderails to cut lengths up to 12-ft. The guiderails cut lengths up to 12-ft.
  • CUTS MULTIPLE KERFS SIMULTANEOUSLY – make up to four cuts in a single pass, ideal for creating perfect radius profiles in drywall, solid wood, or plywood.
  • CUTS CHAMFERS – easily cut clean chamfers in multiple materials
  • PRECISE ADJUSTMENT - The milling depth can be adjusted to the nearest millimeter on a scale of 1/10 using the fine-tuning set screw.
  • PROFESSIONAL – the professional aluminum guide rail system provides precise positioning and stable, repeatable cuts.
  • PRECISION - the milling plate runs along the material surface, which prevents tipping and provides the GROOVE-90 with a secure position even when used in conjunction with a guide rail.
  • CONVENIENT – Quickly and easily remove the protective cover to change blades.
  • ECONOMICAL – the proprietary cutter blades can be rotated to provide 3X the life.
  • SAFE - The power-on lock and blade lock are both activated automatically when you open the protective cover.


 

Kit Includes:

  • GROOVE-90 Motor for Ames GROOVE-90 - GRV90-MA

title: TapeTech 12" Premium Compound Roller 3 Pack
description:
TapeTech 12" Premium Compound Roller 3 Pack CROLL12CG3PK

TapeTech drywall joint compound rollers come in a 3 pack and, are ideal for applying large amounts of drywall compound on walls and ceilings for finishing large patches and butt joints, or skimming entire walls, ceilings and rooms. They are a great alternative to breaking out a sprayer or trying to apply the compound with knives or trowels. Simply apply the joint compound with the TapeTech premium drywall joint compound roller and then skim the area with a TapeTech premium finishing knife for an amazing finish.

Key Features:

  • Highest Quality: TapeTech premium drywall joint compound rollers are manufactured in Europe exclusively for TapeTech, using the highest quality reticulated polypropylene nap for great results and long life.
  • Highest Capacity: TapeTech premium drywall joint compound rollers feature an 18mm nap - nearly 50% thicker than other brands with ½” nap – allowing you to apply nearly 50% more compound to the surface between fills compared to other high nap rollers.
  • Highest Coverage: The unique design and manufacturing of TapeTech premium joint compound rollers releases more compound from the nap and onto the surface, providing the highest coverage rate per roller load.
  • Robust Frame Design: TapeTech premium drywall joint compound rollers are designed for use with TapeTech roller frames. Our frames are a full 5/16” thick – stronger than smaller ¼” thick frames on the market.
  • Comfortable Handle: The TapeTech Roller frames feature a comfortable, two-component over molded handle that provides comfortable handling and positive grip, even when wet.
  • Extended Reach: Easily reach most common walls and ceilings using the TapeTech CROLLHAN2 extendable handle. With super secure attachment and lightweight but robust construction, you’ll quickly knock out any wall coverage or skimming job.
  • Ideal for Skimming: The TapeTech premium drywall joint compound rollers are ideal for quickly applying large amounts of compound over patches, butt joints or entire surfaces. The perfect set up for skimming with TapeTech premium finishing knives.

title: TapeTech 3-Day Pro Skill Training Registration
description:
TapeTech 3-Day Pro Skill Training Registration


 

Check the TapeTech Training Center page for upcoming training dates.


 

To register and pay online, choose the number of registrants you are paying for in the Quantity box above, then add this product to your cart and checkout using any available payment method.


 

Course Overview: This course will teach the skills and techniques required to correctly and efficiently use automatic taping and finishing tools. 
Training Location: TapeTech National Training Center, Suwanee, GA 
Duration: 3 days 
Who should attend: Tool owners and their employees as well as authorized TapeTech Distributors and Dealers. 
Cost: The cost for this two day seminar is $599.00 and includes classroom and hands-on instruction, materials, lunch and snacks each day. Each attendee is responsible for his or her own transportation, lodging and other meal expenses. 
 


 

Day One

  • The Finishing Process
  • ATF Tool overview
  • Mixing the Compound
  • Filling the tools
  • Using the Automatic Taper
  • Using the Corner Roller
  • Intro to Finishing Boxes


 

Day Two

  • Using the EasyClean® Box and MAXXBOX®
  • Using the Power Assist® MAXXBOX®
  • Nail Spotters
  • Corner Applicators and MudRunner®
  • Corner Finishers
  • Common Tool Maintenance


 

Day Three

  • A TapeTech Training Team member will work with you to customize your agenda for your final day at the training center.


 

Payment Information: Course fee of $599.00 per person must be paid in advance to secure your place in the session.


 

Cancellation Policy: Cancellation must be made via e-mail sent to tapetech@tapetech.com.

  • Cancellations received more than 30 days before the first day of session: 75% refund.
  • Cancellations received less than 30 days before the first day of session: 50% refund.
  • Cancellations received less than 15 days before the first day of session: no refund.


 

Additional Information, Terms & Conditions: Successful graduates receive a Certificate of Completion and a TapeTech Polo Shirt. Certificate and polo shirt presented to actual attendees only. Cancellations not eligible for certificate or polo shirt.

The TapeTech 3/8" Leaf & Square Ornamental Tool is designed for professionals who require precision and versatility in their decorative finishing projects. Its dual-ended design, with both a leaf and square shape, allows for intricate detail work and smooth application in tight spaces. The tool’s high carbon steel construction ensures long-lasting durability, while the ergonomic handle offers comfort during extended periods of use. Whether working on Venetian plaster, ornamental designs, or other decorative finishes, this tool consistently delivers professional-grade results.

description:

The TapeTech 8" Bucket Trowel (VBUCKET08) is a purpose-built tool designed for efficiently scooping EIFS, stucco, and mortar directly from buckets and mortar boxes. Constructed from high carbon tempered steel, this bucket trowel delivers superior durability and edge retention compared to standard trowels, ensuring long-lasting performance under demanding job site conditions. The ergonomic ProSoft handle provides a comfortable grip, helping reduce fatigue during extended use and improving overall control.

Beyond scooping, this versatile tool can also be used for buttering bricks, spreading mortar, and smoothing materials, making it a valuable addition to any contractor’s toolkit. Whether you're working with EIFS systems, stucco applications, or masonry projects, this trowel is designed to increase efficiency and deliver consistent results.


Key Features:


  • Square-shaped blade for efficient scooping with less material waste
  • High carbon tempered steel for durability and long life
  • Ergonomic ProSoft grip for comfort and reduced fatigue
  • Ideal for EIFS, stucco, mortar, and masonry applications
  • Multi-use design for scooping, buttering, and smoothing

title: TapeTech EIFSand™ 18V Cordless Dual Disc Sander
description:
The TapeTech 18V Dual Disc Sander provides the ultimate portability and freedom on the jobsite to quickly sand EPS/XPS panels and many other materials, saving time and money. The 8" dual disc design features contra-rotation of the discs to provide optimal balance during operation and the independent motor reduces the weight of the tool in the worker's hands. The sander motor hangs from your belt leaving the sander weighing just 5 pounds. The brushless motor includes electronic soft-start and overload protection for dependability and low maintenance. 


 

The wide surface area produces a more even surface compared to smaller, standard size hand rasps. Powerful 5.0 Ah batteries sand up to 950 square feet on a single charge. Continuous speed control optimizes performance and maintains speed even under heavy loads. Use a TapeTech battery adapter (sold separately) to quickly and easily use your Bosch, Makita, Milwaukee or DeWalt batteries to keep the sander running all day.


 

The sander features an exhaust outlet that is easily connected to the TapeTech Model EIFSVAC120/EIFSVAC18V Backpack Vacuum, or other vacuums, for increased mobility and a dust free work area.  The TapeTech 18V Dual Disc Sander is perfect for working from scaffolding, eliminating cords and increasing mobility. Get the only dustless vacuum drywall hand sander on the market today!


 

The kit includes (2) 5.0 Ah batteries and a 30-minute TapeTech battery quick charger for continuous work.

Norton ProSand Corner Sanding Sponge

The ProSand Corner Sanding Sponge is a super-sharp abrasive. This sponge features new coating method that resist clogging, cut faster and last longer than general sanding sponges (5X longer than conventional sandpaper). These sponges offer maximum versatility and flexibility for sanding curved, contoured or flat surfaces of wood, metal, paint, plastic, and drywall.

Features:

  • Durable, abrasive-coated foam lasts up to 5X longer than sandpaper with resistance to tearing
  • Flexible and conformable to shapes and contours making sanding of various surfaces and hard-to-reach areas easier

  • Washable for extended life; rinse and reuse

  • Grit - Medium

title: TapeTech Pro Stainless Steel Hand Tool Set
description:
TapeTech Pro Stainless Steel Hand Tool Set

TapeTech Premium Mud Pans feature stainless steel construction and a contoured bottom to make mixing, cleaning and removal of joint compound easier. The contoured shape is more ergonomic and comfortable to hold. The continuous heli-arc weld provides maximum durability and value.

TapeTech Premium Taping and Jointing Knives feature the optimal combination of design, materials experience and testing to produce knives with the best balance, flex, comfort, and control so you achieve premium results when applying and smoothing joint compound.

The handle’s over-sized, tapered shape provides the most ergonomic, slip-resistant grip. The enlarged, alloy hammer end allows it to be used to set protruding fasteners, adjust installation flaws, and protect against damage if the knife is dropped.

TapeTech Premium Taping and Joint Knife blades are precision ground and polished to provide the perfect amount of flex and finish. The Carbon Steel and Stainless Steel blades provide ultimate feel.

TapeTech Premium Taping Knives feature the strongest backing plate in the industry, preventing unwanted blade deflection while providing smooth, consistent control and finish.

Set Includes:

  • 1 - TapeTech 3.5" Carbon Steel Pointing Knife
  • 1 - TapeTech 6" Carbon Steel Clipped Joint Knife
  • 1 - TapeTech 4" Stainless Steel Joint Knife
  • 1 - TapeTech 5" Stainless Steel Joint Knife
  • 1 - TapeTech 6" Stainless Steel Joint Knife
  • 1 - TapeTech 8" Stainless Steel Taping Knife

title: OX 4-Piece Construction Rig - Oil-Tanned Leather
description:
OX Pro Series 4-Piece Construction Rig - Oil-Tanned Leather

Built for all day comfort and long life, even on the most demanding job sites, the OX Tools 4-piece Construction Rig easily stores all of the tools needed for everyday use. Pouches are secured with heavy-duty rivets that have a low profile to reduce chance of scratching surfaces. Double stitching and belt tunnel reinforcements are designed to withstand the vigorous conditions of the job site. All four pieces are constructed with high-quality oil-tanned leather and include: a framer's tool bag, a 3 pouch fastener bag, a hammer holder, and 3" tool belt for a total of 22 pockets. If you can't find a spot for for what you need in this rig, you're probably doing it wrong. The fastener bag serves as the primarily nail bag with a slot between the two front pouches for a layout square - plus, it features a pencil/marker pouch and a scabbard for a claw bar. The tool bag has inner pockets for hand tools as well as another pencil/marker pouch and it includes a tape measure clip for quick access. The dedicated hammer holder offers flexibility in placement for quick muscle-memory retrieval.

Features:

  • Top Grain Oil-Tanned Saddle Leather
  • 22 Tool Holders And Pocket Layouts
  • Heavy Duty Rivets And Stitching
  • 3" Wide Leather Tool Belt
  • Fits Waist Size 29" - 46"

title: Mirka LEROS Orbital Sanding System
description:
Mirka LEROS Orbital Sanding System

Years of development work and a determined focus on ergonomics and user-friendliness resulted in the lightest brushless electric wall and ceiling sander on the market, the Mirka® LEROS. This lightweight sander can be used for longer periods in greater comfort. The Mirka® LEROS is the first wall sander with 180° flexibility on the sanding head, which helps the operator reach surfaces from a better angle and allows a more ergonomic working position. The random orbital movement gives precise responses to the operator’s movements. The special sanding head and backing pad design make it possible to work very close to corners and edges. The fixation point of the sanding head is close to the surface, stabilizing the sanding process. Bluetooth connectivity offers additional features via the myMirka app, helping you to keep track of vibration, speed and usage data.

 

Lightweight
The lightest wall and ceiling sander on the market, which means the operator can sand for longer periods while limiting strain.

 

Flexible Sanding Head
A flexible sanding head enables the tool to easily follow the operator’s movements and permits a more ergonomic working position.

 

5 mm Random Orbital Movement
The LEROS is much easier to operate compared to traditional rotary sanders. The random orbital movement enables an easy handling of the tool for a better finish, meaning fewer interruptions due to fatigue and less re-working.

 

Full Force System
Due to the lack of springs and brushes there is no need to press the tool against the wall when sanding. Instead the complete force is transferred to the sanding process.

 

Brushless Motor Technology
The brushless motor reduces the weight of the tool significantly. In addition, less maintenance is needed since there are no carbon brushes that need to be changed and no loss in efficiency under heavy pressure.

 

Dust-free
To enable efficient dust-free sanding the shroud has two suction points and a pad that is optimised for Abranet sanding discs. The operator saves time, money, and the working environment is cleaner and healthier.

 

Specifications:

  • Power Input - 350 W
  • Speed - 4,000–8,000 rpm
  • Orbit - 5.0 mm
  • Noise Level - LPA 73 DB
  • Vibration Level - < 2.5 M/S2
  • Length - 144 CM
  • Weight - 3.5 KG
  • Size of pad - 225 MM
 

Pack Includes:

  • 1 - Mirka® LEROS Power Sander

title: TapeTech Premium Finishing Knife Extendable Handle  + Adapter
description:
TapeTech Premium Finishing Knife Extendable Handle (XHTT) + Premium Finishing Knife Adapter (PFKHATT)


An interchangeable, extendable handle system that allows one support handle to be used with Corner Rollers, Angle Boxes, Angle Heads, Nail Spotters, and Skimming Blades/Finishing Knives! The base handle XHTT fits the corner roller without adapters, as well as the new design corner applicator and nail spotter without adapters. The new, optimal 1.25" diameter makes TapeTech XHTT handles the most ergonomic in the industry.


The Premium Finishing Knife Handle adapter PFKHATT is more robust, provides quick angle adjustment and improved durability. The Handle Adapter quickly and securely attaches to the TapeTech FHTT or XHTT Support handles. The D-Shape fitting prevents twisting. This handle adapter also features a robust wing nut and quick-release cam locks, for easy removal.

  • Single Handle With Attachments For A Variety Of Tools
  • D-Shaped Fitting Eliminates Corner Box Movement
  • Comfortable and Ergonomic
  • Extendable from 43"-77"
  • Lightweight Only 2.15lbs
  • 1.25" Diameter

XHTT Handle Fitments and Adapters:

  • The Corner Applicator Adapter (CAA-TT)

  • Extendable Support Handle XHTT

title: DeWalt Cordless 20V MAX Drywall Sander With 10 Gal Vac
description:
DeWalt Cordless 20V MAX Drywall Sander With 10 Gal Vac


This Cordless Drywall Sander features increased runtime, durability, and speed consistency with a brushless motor, quick dust extractor connection with The Airlock™ connection for use with DEWALT dust extractors, and additional control with a variable speed dial. The DCE800 works well in hard-to-reach and compact workspaces with a telescoping shaft and articulating head. To efficiently remove potentially harmful dust in the workplace, the tool is equipped with Wireless Tool Control™ for pairing with compatible DEWALT dust extractors.


20V MAX Cordless Drywall Sander Features:


  • Improved runtime, durability, and less maintenance with a brushless motor
  • Easy access to confined spaces and hard-to-reach areas with a telescoping shaft
  • Wireless ON/OFF capability when paired with a compatible dust extractor via Wireless Tool Control™
  • Quick, secure, and tool-free connection to DEWALT Dust Extractors via Airlock™
  • Additional control with the variable speed dial
  • Sanding pad maintains contact to surface at various angles with the articulating head
  • Compatible with DWE7801 Soft and DWE7802 Hard backing pads
  • 30 minutes of runtime when used with DCB205
  • Helps to reduce fatique with a balanced tool weight distribution
  • 1 - 20V MAX Cordless Drywall Sander DCE800
  • 1 - Charger DCB115
  • 1 - 20V MAX* XR® Batteries DCB205

DeWalt 10 Gal HEPA Vac Features:


  • Automatic Filter Clean pulses every 30 seconds for continuous operations without stopping to clean filter
  • Powerful 15 Amp motor delivers 140 CFM of airflow for maximum suction
  • Power Tool Actuation controls the On/Off operations of the vacuum with a power tool
  • Meets the EPA Lead Related Renovations, Repair and Painting (RRP) Rule for Hepa Vacuum only when DWV9320 Filter is used (Filter included with unit)
  • Variable Suction controls vacuum's power consumption and amount of suction
  • Telescoping handle for easy transport
  • Universal hose connector provides a robust connection with swivel capability
  • Lightweight and portable weighing in at only 33.5 lbs
  • Heavy duty wheels and locking casters provide jobsite durability
  • Multiple lift and tie down points to secure vac to scaffolding or during transportation
  • Simple one switch operation to select tool actuation or vac only
  • Unit comes fully assembled
  • Can be used with wet or dry applications

description:
Graco PowerFill 3.5 XL Loading Pump Pro Series

CHANGE THE WAY YOU WORK FOREVER

Introducing the industry's first cordless, powered loading pump designed to fill all automatic taping and finishing tools. PowerFill totally eliminates the need to manually pump. Now you can quickly fill with just the push of a button—eliminating daily fatigue and long-term injury.

WHERE SMART MEETS JOBSITE TOUGH

the Integrated SmartControl offers single-button pumping Precision Fill Technology* automatically refills tools to your preset level—saving time. The ProConnect™ tool-less removal offers easy removal for storage or pump cleaning

NEVER HAND-PUMP AGAIN

The Power Fill is programmable to automatically refill tools with Precision Fill*, up to 3.5 gpm for lightning-fast filling—all day, every day. The lightweight, compact design is perfect for any location, even tight scissor-lifts. The Power Fill quickly converts, for right or left hand users for maximum flexibility and pumps up to 55 gallons on a single battery charge.

AUTOMATICALLY FILL WITH PRECISION FILL

Increase overall job productivity so you can get more done! Fill your tools, pans or hawks to your preset level — with the push of a button. Regardless of battery condition or pump speed accurately fill to within 1/4oz every time. The hands-free, continuous pumping mode, is perfect for loading or unloading bulk containers, and for the easiest cleaning — just let it run!

WORK SMARTER, FINISH FASTER

  • Built For Large Residential and Commercial Contractor
  • Everyday Finishing
  • Medium to Large Jobs
  • Designed To Increase Productivity

title: Drywall Texture Roller (Serengeti)
description:
Drywall Texture Roller (Serengeti)

Final texture effect can vary based on the following variables:

  1. Thickness of the compound used:
    • A thicker mixture of compound will produce a final result with more definition in the pattern.
    • A Thinner mixture of compound will produce a much more subtle texture effect.

  2. Depth of compound once it’s applied:
    • The more material that is applied, the more dramatic the final texture will be when cross-lit.
    • The less material that is applied, the more subtle the final texture will be.

  3. Method of application:
    • A common method of application is to coat the finished surface with compound, either with a heavy nap paint roller, or a drywall finishing knife or trowel, then apply a pattern using a texture brush or roller.

  1. Thickness of the compound used:
    • A thicker mixture of compound will produce a final result with more definition in the pattern.
    • A Thinner mixture of compound will produce a much more subtle texture effect.

  2. Depth of compound once it’s applied:
    • The more material that is applied, the more dramatic the final texture will be when cross-lit.
    • The less material that is applied, the more subtle the final texture will be.

  3. Method of application:
    • A common method of application is to coat the finished surface with compound, either with a heavy nap paint roller, or a drywall finishing knife or trowel, then apply a pattern using a texture brush or roller.

title: TapeTech Carbon Fiber Automatic Taper 07TT-C
description:
TapeTech Carbon Fiber EasyClean® Automatic Taper

The Lightest TapeTech Taper Ever! TapeTech is excited to introduce the new 07TT-C Carbon Fiber Automatic Taper. At just 5.65 pounds, the 07TT-C is up to 20% lighter than standard tapers, which helps in reducing worker fatigue. The main tube and the control tube are carbon fiber, a material that will not dent and is temperature-neutral. No more cold tubes in the winter or hot tubes in the summer!

Features Include:

Easy Grip Control Tube. The control tube has been lengthened 2.5" and glide wheels added to make tape cuts easier and more comfortable. The glide wheels are recessed into flanges at each end of the control tube, and act as stops for your hands - requiring much less grip-force to operate the cutter.

Quick-Change Tape Bail Locks into place, making it easy to change tape rolls without having to put the taper down. Best of all, there are no loose parts to misplace or re-install. To change tape rolls, grasp the tape retainer wire near the end of the spool post and depress it down and out through the retainer slot. Swing the retainer wire up and out of the way, change tape rolls, sliding the new roll fully onto the spool post. Swing the retainer wire back down, and guide it into the retainer slot. It’s that simple!

No Hassle Cable Changes. The plunger stop has been improved to simplify cable changes. The metal and exposed screw heads have been replaced with a smooth, rounded, plastic plunger stop that is easy to remove and re-install. To remove the plunger stop, lift the locking tab and twist the stop ¼ turn counterclockwise. After twisting, pull the stop off the taper and complete the cable change following the normal procedure (see Cable Replacement). To re-install, align the guide tabs to the slots and slide the stop into the taper end, twisting ¼ turn clockwise. Continue twisting until the tab snaps into place, locking the assembly together. If oriented correctly, very little force should be required to install the stop. Changing a cable has never been easier!

Adjustable Braking System. This feature allows you to adjust the braking system for your personal preference. Now you have the control over the brake. It also can be adjusted tighter or looser to account for wear on your taper.

Columbia Taping Tools introduces the world's first Mini Carbon Fiber Taper, The Predator "Sawed Off" Mini. Another unique benefit of this Dent Proof construction, is that Carbon Fiber maintains temperature stability, meaning this taper will remain warm to the touch. The 6 wheel cutting sleeve has been updated in favor of teflon sliders which gives the operator a smoother glide and better grip. Now, changing the sliders out is simple field maintenance and can be installed with a standard screwdriver in minutes as opposed to half an hour or more. The pull ring is ideal for higher ceilings. The Predator will tape flats and angles effortlessly with less drag in the corners. The quick release cap makes cleaning a breeze and the stainless steel side plates, cable drum, and creaser arms offer a lifetime of corrosion resistance. With style, functionality, and durability the Predator from Columbia takes the -Evolution of Taping- to a whole new level. Predator "Sawed Off" Mini is perfect for taping drywall in small rooms and closets when a full size taper is too cumbersome.

title: DeWalt 8 Gallon HEPA Vac with AutoClean
description:
The DeWalt 8 Gallon HEPA Vac with Automatic Filter Cleaning DWV010

Provides a powerful yet portable solution for keeping the job site clean during and after heavy-duty applications. Not only does the 15-amp motor deliver 150 CFM of airflow for maximum suction, a variable suction function allows you to manually control the level of suction and the level of power consumption based on the task at hand.

Capable of being used for both wet and dry applications, the DWV010 comes with two top-of-the-line HEPA filters to capitalize on cleaning power. Heavy-duty wheels, locking casters, a telescoping handle, and a kink-resistant hose make it convenient for transport around the job site to clean up after woodworking and masonry projects.

Exact Dust Extraction, The DWV010 8-gallon dust extractor with automatic filter doesn’t leave its cleaning capability to chance—its automatic filter clean pulses every 30 seconds for continual operation, eliminating the need to stop and manually clean the filter. Between that convenient feature and the simple one-switch operation to select vacuum only or tool actuation when paired with a power tool, cleanup is more efficient than ever.

title: DeWalt 10 Gal Pro Pack with Hyde Discs
description:
DeWalt 10 Gal Pro Pack with Hyde Discs

The Perfect Combo to take your sanding to the dust-free level! All-Wall's Best Value Pro Pack! - 45 Hyde Abranet Sanding Discs

DeWalt 4.7 AMP Drywall Sander DWE7800 will have you wondering how you sanded without it. Any serious drywall contractor needs this to get the job done better and more efficiently. When attached to the included DeWalt 10 Gallon HEPA Vac DWV012 with the 13' Anti-Static Vacuum Hose, you can have a dust-free sanding experience. When inside for a remodel this becomes crucial to getting the job done. With the addition of an articulated sanding head you have the ability to sand a much wider area without having to move around.

Achieve a smooth, polished finish with this 4.7 AMP electric drywall sander. The DWE7800 is a lifesaver when up on scaffolding while sanding. In order to maximize control and comfort, the motor is located on the opposite side of the sanding head, sand more efficiently and for longer periods. The variable speed dial and dual-action trigger provides control and versatility in a variety of applications. The 9" hook-and-loop sanding pad quickly connects to sanding paper and mesh, while the articulating head allows for better reach in workspaces. To efficiently remove dust in the workplace. This electric drywall sander is equipped with an Airlock™ connection to securely attach to compatible DeWalt dust extractors.

DeWalt 10 Gallon HEPA Vac with AutoClean DWV012 provides a powerful yet portable solution for keeping the job site clean during and after heavy-duty applications. Not only does the 15-amp motor deliver 140 CFM of airflow for maximum suction, a variable suction function allows you to manually control the level of suction and the level of power consumption based on the task at hand. Capable of being used for both wet and dry applications, the DWV012 comes with two top-of-the-line HEPA filters to capitalize on cleaning power. Heavy-duty wheels, locking casters, a telescoping handle, and a kink-resistant hose make it convenient for transport around the job site to clean up after woodworking and masonry projects.

The Norton Abrasives Back-Up Pad is designed for use with hook & loop sanding discs. Using the hook & loop system is more economical and effective than using the stock pads with glued abrasive. Use several sheets of sanding discs without having to replace the foam back-up pad each time. The foam pad easily attaches to sander with the stock nut. The Hyde Abranet abrasive resin bond cuts more aggressively and extends the life of the drywall disc. Experience increased lifespan over traditional drywall sanding disc products, of up to 4X. The cloth backing is far more durable than paper and resists tearing.

  • Fast Connection: 9" Hook & Loop Sanding Pad
  • Variable Speed Dial
  • Dual-Action Trigger Enables Momentary and Locked-On Usage
  • Tool-Free Connection To DeWalt Dust Extractors Via Airlock™
  • Automatic Filter Clean

  • Save $ on Sanding Discs

title: TapeTech 3.5" EasyRoll Angle Head 48XTT
description:
TapeTech 3.5" EasyRoll® Angle Head

Reduces drag with easy rolling rubber-tired wheels. Used to perfectly feather both sides of internal drywall tape corners in one pass. Integrated spring adjusters allow quick change of spring tension to suit any drywall finishing job. 3.5" EasyRoll angle head can also be attached to angle box, corner box or Mudrunner to apply final smooth feathered finish to inside drywall corner angles.

Tape Tech Easy Roll 3.5" corner finishing tool glides smoothly in drywall corners due to reduced friction. Use angle head to feather inside 90 degree tape corners after applying with banjo, compound applicator or automatic taper. EasyRoll angle corner finisher can also be used to apply final smooth feathered finish coat of compound, by simply attaching to an angle box (also known as flusher box, hockey box or corner applicator). Convenient spring adjustment levers quickly allow change of tension preference. Firm spring adjustment is often used when final finishing inside drywall angles, and softer setting is popular when applying tape coat. The 3.5" EasyRoll corner finisher can be used both for applying tape as well as smooth skimming finish compound to inside 90 degree drywall angle corners.

  • Convenient Spring Tension Levers
  • Locking Clip Retainer Eliminates Damaging Disconnects
  • EasyRoll Wheels With Rubber Tires Reduce Friction
  • Evenly finishes Both Sides Of Inside 90 degree angles
  • 5-Year Manufacturer's Warranty

TapeTech 2" Angle Head

Used to perfectly feather both sides of internal drywall tape corners in one pass. The corner finisher, also known as corner finisher, angle finisher, or glazer, is attached to a corner applicator, angle box, MudRunner® or angle head handle to quickly and professionally finish internal drywall corners. The TapeTech 2" corner finisher angle head is ideal for tape coats and for finishing drywall projects with narrow door legs or window trim areas.   • Additional braking, control, and range of motion versus competitor handles

title: Jöst Premium 9in Sanding Discs 320 Grit 15ct
description:
Jöst Abrasives, Simply A Better Drywall Sanding Disc.

Jöst 9" Round Sanding Discs 15pk - Specially designed drywall sanding discs for use with with 9" Drywall Power Sanders. Perfect for dust free drywall sanding. Jöst Abrasives drywall sanding discs produce the highest quality results.

Here's Why:

  • Perforation - Jöst drywall sanding products have holes throughout the surface that allow the dust to easily escape, and Eliminate Load-up. Because you won't have dust particles clogging up your disc, you can now see the full potential abrasive life of the disc. Perforation allows the sheet to last longer and provide a higher level of finish. Dust is extracted through the perforations in a congestion-free-flow - not just at the edges of the sander, but over the entire surface!
  • Fiber Backing - Jöst abrasive drywall sanding sheets utilize a Non-Woven backing that draws the dust through the portholes evenly. Not only is the backing a nice additional cushion, but it drastically improves the performance and life of the sanding disc. Even distribution of sanded drywall material means you can Eliminate Sand Scratches!
  • Aluminum Oxide Grit - Traditional drywall sandpaper uses sharp edged silicon carbide abrasive that starts out cutting hard, but doesn't wear evenly. Jöst Drywall Sanding Discs utilize Aluminum Oxide grit that is rounded (instead of jagged), and wears uniformly. Jöst products will cut at the same rate throughout their usable life, and will resist loading.

Features:

  • 320 Grit
  • 9" Discs
  • 15 Discs Per Pack
  • Requires Jöst Useit Interface Pad

title: Trim-Tex Buttboard Drywall Backer 48" Case of 12
description:
Buttboard™ Drywall Backer installs between studs on butt joints, and pulls back the edges - creating a tapered edge that requires less joint compound to finish. The end result is a factory like edge that requires less compound, sanding, and labor - Buttboard Saves You Time & Money

Trim-Tex Buttboard™ Drywall Backer produced Flat Butt Joints also reduce carpentry labor costs, and improve the overall quality of the finished product. Save time and material handling with easier butt joint layout between wall and ceiling framing members. No special tools required for installation, and using Buttboard allows the use of shorter drywall sheets.

Trim-Tex Buttboard™ Drywall Backer 48" Features:

  • Finish butt joints smooth and easy with a factory-like tapered edge
  • Save approximately 1/2 mud, sanding, and labor to finish butts
  • Cut back and save on carpentry costs associated with drywall butt joints
  • Works with metal and wood framing without special tools or fasteners
  • Use with any thickness of drywall and allows for use of shorter sheets
  • Made from Formaldehyde free premium density OSB board.

How to install Buttboard Drywall Backer

  1. Install first sheet of drywall with butt end centered between framing members. Install screws in surround of drywall sheet, except for framing members closest to butt end.
  2. Center BUTTBOARD on backside of drywall butt joint TM with machined groove facing the backside of drywall. Install screws every 8-12 inches, one inch back from drywall butt edge.
  3. Butt end of second drywall sheet to end of first sheet. (Do not compress butt joint). Install screws into surround of drywall sheet except for framing member closest to butt joint.
  4. Firmly push butt end of second sheet into BUTTBOARD TM and install screws every 8-12", one inch back from butt edge.
  5. Finish screwing both sheets of drywall to framing members.
    6. Screws can also be installed through adjoining drywall sheet into overlapping BUTTBOARD
  6. Tape and mud the butt joint. To improve the strength and workability of your drywall compound, we recommend you use Trim-Tex Mud-Max, stock # 850.

title: Columbia 55" Cam-Lock Compound Mud Tube
description:
Columbia 55" Cam Lock Compound Mud Tube

Fills like a syringe, simply insert the tube into the compound bucket with the plunger rod collapsed, pulling the plunger rod out fills the tube with compound. Depress the plunger rod to dispense compound. Simply an Easy way to apply compound to the wall.

Featuring a smooth syringe action supported by a plunger bushing - Easy push and fill with an extra high quality aluminum tube, head, and swap out implement ball. The newly improved version of the original compound mud tube, includes brass cams and a stainless steel lock ring feature that allows for easy access for cleaning and other routine maintenance. Columbia tubes are true professional grade, and the aluminum main components won't bust, crack or easily break like the competition.

Columbia Compound Tubes Work With:

  • Better Than Ever Brand Mud Heads
  • Red Diamond Implements
  • All Brands Of Direct Flushers
  • All Brands Of Corner Bead Heads
  • All Brands Of Angle Head/Corner Finishers

Features:

  • Lightweight Aluminum Tube & Plunger Rod
  • Self Lubricating Plunger Bushing For Easy Push
  • Long Lasting Billet Aluminum Nose Cone
  • Includes Strong And Durable Aluminum Implement Ball For Flushers and Applicators
  • Brass Cams On A Stainless Steel Lock Ring
  • Quick Remove Bottom For Complete Cleaning

Hand Made in Columbia's State Of The Art Facility In Canada With U.S. Aluminum and Steel Components.

title: Kraft 16" x 5" Elite Leather Handle Trowel
description:
When only the best will do, Kraft Elite Series Plaster/Drywall Trowels are what the professionals reach for. By using state of the art machinery, these trowels are individually finished with a precision ground edge. This precision grinding performed by state of the art machinery in the USA gives the trowel a "broken-in" blade ready for immediate use. The Golden Stainless blade is specially treated to achieve a higher degree of flexibility that makes finishing drywall and plaster easier than conventional trowels. The leather grip is unique to the Kraft Elite Series and helps to wick away sweat from your hand for a more secure grip when wet.

    Kraft CFE545L Elite Series 16" x 5" Trowel Features:

  • Stainless Steel Rivets in the mount give exceptional strength where it is needed most
  • Precision ground edges give it a "broken-in" feel from the first use
  • Included with each trowel is a trowel holder to protect the trowel and to allow hanging storage
  • Heat treated golden stainless steel gives you greater flexibility and durability and the special alloy used will not rust, pit or stain.
  • Secure grip leather handle wicks away sweat and moisture
  • Made in the USA

title: Kraft 14" x 5" Elite Leather Handle Trowel
description:
When only the best will do, Kraft Elite Series Plaster/Drywall Trowels are what the professionals reach for. By using state of the art machinery, these trowels are individually finished with a precision ground edge. This precision grinding performed by state of the art machinery in the USA gives the trowel a "broken-in" blade ready for immediate use. The Golden Stainless blade is specially treated to achieve a higher degree of flexibility that makes finishing drywall and plaster easier than conventional trowels. The leather grip is unique to the Kraft Elite Series and helps to wick away sweat from your hand for a more secure grip when wet.

    Kraft CFE543L Elite Series 14"x5" Trowel Features:

  • Stainless Steel Rivets in the mount give exceptional strength where it is needed most
  • Precision ground edges give it a "broken-in" feel from the first use
  • Included with each trowel is a trowel holder to protect the trowel and to allow hanging storage
  • Heat treated golden stainless steel gives you greater flexibility and durability and the special alloy used will not rust, pit or stain.
  • Secure grip leather handle wicks away sweat and moisture
  • Made in the USA

title: Hyde Net Abrasive Sanding Discs 240 Grit
description:
Hyde Net Abrasive Sanding Discs 240 Grit

Specifically developed for sanding drywall putty, primers, lacquers, composite materials and a wide range of other materials for industrial use. These disks combine high performance and a longer lifespan than traditional abrasives, making it a cost-effective solution. Designed for dry sanding by machine or by hand, its true dust-free sanding characteristics result in a cleaner work environment, as well as a better surface finish.

The abrasive resin bond cuts more aggressively and extends the life of the drywall disc. Experience increased lifespan over traditional drywall sanding disc products, of up to 4X. The cloth backing is far more durable than paper and resists tearing.

Featuring:

  • High performance mesh abrasive designed to sand drywall compounds
  • Superior performance to drywall screen - less scratches
  • Perfect for use with drywall dustless sanders
  • Resin bonded abrasive cuts more aggressively and last longer
  • Lasts up to 4X longer than traditional drywall sandpaper
  • Cloth backing resist tearing and makes for a more consistent finish
  • 15 Pack of 9" Round Sanding Discs

title: TapeTech Extendable Angle Box Handle XHTT/CAA
description:
TapeTech XHTT/CAA is an all-new aluminum extendable angle box handle that is part of an interchangeable handle system. One support handle can be used with Corner Rollers, Angle Boxes, Angle Heads, and Nail Spotters! The base handle XHTT fits the corner roller without adapters, as well as the new design corner applicator and nail spotter without adapters. The new, optimal 1.25" diameter makes TapeTech XHTT handles the most ergonomic in the industry. The XHTT features a D-shaped fitting that securely positions the handle in the Corner Applicator and positively prevents the tool from rotating during use.

    TapeTech XHTT/CAA Interchangeable Handle Kit Features:

  • Includes the CAA adapter for older style corner finisher boxes or angle boxes
  • Extendable from 43"-77"
  • Lightweight and maneuverable at only 2.15 lbs
  • Use a single handle with attachments for a variety of tools.
  • 1.25" Diameter is comfortable and ergonomic
  • D-Shaped fitting end that eliminates corner box movement

    Handle Fitments and Adapters:

  • The Corner Applicator adapter (CAA-TT) is included with the new Corner Applicators (CA07TT and CA08TT). Or you can purchase it separately to use the new handle system with your existing Corner Applicators.
  • The Nail Spotter adapter (NSA-TT) is included with the new Nail Spotters (Models NS02TT and NS03TT). Or you can purchase it separately to use the new handle system with your existing Nail Spotters.
  • If you have the current 35TT or 50TT Corner Applicators, you need the FHTT or the XHTT plus the CAA-TT adapter.
  • If you have the current 63TT or 68TT Nail Spotters, you need the FHTT or the XHTT plus the NSA-TT adapter.

title: TapeTech 12" EasyClean Flat Box EZ12TT
description:
TapeTech 12" EasyClean™ Flat Box EZ12TT

The rigid design allows the flat box to apply just the right amount of drywall joint compound, feathering both edges at the same time. The main extrusion strongly supports side plates for greater strength. Ideal for applying for applying finish coat to drywall flat seams or butt joints, These boxes will also fit all major brands of flat box handles.

The EasyRoll™ wheel system allows you to expertly finish all types of outside corner bead up to two times faster than finishing by hand. EasyRoll™ wheels work with all types of outside corner bead including metal, paper-faced, vinyl and bullnose. These wheels provide a shoulder to guide the finishing box along the corner bead without after-market attachments or damage to the axle. The shoulder of the EasyRoll™ wheels are more than three times wider than after-market products, making it easier to place, and keep the finishing box on the corner bead. EasyRoll™ wheels are engineered and designed to be perfectly aligned with the finishing blade, eliminating the need to tilt the finishing box like you must with common after-market wheel systems.

  • Perfect For Finish Coats On Flat Seams and Butt Joints.
  • Coat Corner Bead With EZ Roll Wheels
  • Quick Release Thumb Latches For Easy Cleanup
  • Rigid Shell Design
  • Easy Blade Carrier Dial Adjustment For Precision
  • Fits All Major Brand Drywall Flat Box Handles
  • 5-Year Manufacturer's Warranty.

title: Net Abrasive Drywall Sheets 240 Grit 10pk
description:
Net Abrasive Drywall Sheets 240 Grit 10pk

Are specifically developed for sanding drywall putty, primers, lacquers, composite materials and a wide range of other materials for industrial use. These sheets combine high performance and a longer lifespan than traditional abrasives, making it a cost-effective solution. Designed for dry sanding by machine or by hand, its true dust-free sanding characteristics result in a cleaner work environment, as well as a better surface finish.

title: Jöst Premium 9" Drywall Sanding Discs 220 Grit 15ct
description:
Jöst Abrasives, Simply A Better Drywall Sanding Disc.

Jöst 9" Round Sanding Discs 15pk - Specially designed drywall sanding discs for use with with 9" Drywall Power Sanders. Perfect for dust free drywall sanding. Jöst Abrasives drywall sanding discs produce the highest quality results.

Here's Why:

  • Perforation - Jöst drywall sanding products have holes throughout the surface that allow the dust to easily escape, and Eliminate Load-up. Because you won't have dust particles clogging up your disc, you can now see the full potential abrasive life of the disc. Perforation allows the sheet to last longer and provide a higher level of finish. Dust is extracted through the perforations in a congestion-free-flow - not just at the edges of the sander, but over the entire surface!
  • Fiber Backing - Jöst abrasive drywall sanding sheets utilize a Non-Woven backing that draws the dust through the portholes evenly. Not only is the backing a nice additional cushion, but it drastically improves the performance and life of the sanding disc. Even distribution of sanded drywall material means you can Eliminate Sand Scratches!
  • Aluminum Oxide Grit - Traditional drywall sandpaper uses sharp edged silicon carbide abrasive that starts out cutting hard, but doesn't wear evenly. Jöst Drywall Sanding Discs utilize Aluminum Oxide grit that is rounded (instead of jagged), and wears uniformly. Jöst products will cut at the same rate throughout their usable life, and will resist loading.

Features:

  • 220 Grit
  • 9" Discs
  • 15 Discs Per Pack
  • Requires Jöst Useit Interface Pad

title: TapeTech 2.5" Angle Head 42TT
description:
TapeTech 2.5" Angle Head

Used to perfectly feather both sides of internal drywall tape corners in one pass. The corner finisher, also known as corner finisher, angle finisher, or glazer, is attached to a corner applicator, angle box, MudRunner® or angle head handle to quickly and professionally finish internal drywall corners. An angle head can be used for any 90º inside drywall corner, at either wall or ceiling junctions, and embeds inside angle tape on walls and ceilings by smoothly feathering excess mud in internal corners. TapeTech Corner Finishers are spring loaded to help compensate for slight corner imperfections.

The TapeTech 2.5" corner finisher angle head is ideal for tape coats and for finishing drywall projects with narrow door legs or window trim areas. Stainless steel frames provide many years of reliable service and positive ball retainer keeps angle head securely attached to angle box, Mudrunner or angle head handle, eliminating surprise disconnects or tool damage.

  • Locking Clip Retainer Eliminates Damaging Disconnects.
  • Perfect For Glazing Tape Coat
  • Narrow Side Legs
  • Welded Steel Frames
  • Durable Nickel-Plating
  • Die-cast aluminum body resists corrosion

The unique shape of the Mega Whip causes a vortex effect in the bucket for an even consistency to the material you are mixing and an extremely fast mix.

The mixer is just 8 1/2" long and is designed to perfectly fit in a standard mud pan and mount on any standard drill, giving you precise control of your mixing.

title: Columbia 3" Nail Spotter w/ X1 Ext Handle
description:
Columbia Taping Tools 3" Nail Spotter has been updated and redesigned for greater usability and durability! Hinged door design is easy to push with or without springs. Integrated thumb latch for door release makes clean-up a breeze. All-new gasket resists solvent based lubricants, and integrated tension screw makes adjustments a snap.

Skid Plates & Wheels
The Columbia Nail Spotter design uses a traditional skid plate, but optional wheels are integrated and available. Skid plates offer a greater amount of protection against screw and nail clickers. Wheels track smoother along the wall, and generally add a higher level of control. Regardless of your skid plate preference, the Columbia Spotters have your nail spots covered!

Stop Floppin'
One of the weak points on traditional nail spotters was the handle pivot joint. Older designs required turning a nut with a wrench to get the correct tension on the nail box. Most of the time the tension would quickly change, and the nail box would flop around - It's frustrating and inefficient. Columbia has eliminated the frustration with a simple Thumb Screw Adjustment on the pivot point. The Columbia Nail Spotter design uses a traditional skid plate, but optional wheels are integrated and available. Skid plates offer a greater amount of protection against screw and nail clickers. Wheels track smoother along the wall, and generally add a higher level of control. Regardless of your skid plate preference, the Columbia Spotters have your nail spots covered!

Stop Floppin'
One of the weak points on traditional nail spotters was the handle pivot joint. Older designs required turning a nut with a wrench to get the correct tension on the nail box. title: No-Coat Pro Corner Roll
description:
NO-COAT® PRO Corner Roll

CertainTeed NO-COAT® PRO Corner provides a perfect corner by fitting every angle, every time. Applied with joint compound, it is ideal for production work, long columns and soffits. When used with the NO-COAT® PRO machine, production time is dramatically reduced and waste is virtually eliminated. All the benefits of CertainTeed NO-COAT® make it the optimal product for every angle.

NO-COAT® PRO CORNER is designed for exclusive use with NO-COAT® PRO. Perfect for runs under 10' (3 m). Great for all off angles, stand ups and hiding areas of irregular framing.

WORKING WITH THE PRODUCT

SITE CONDITIONS
The room temperature and wallboard should be maintained at 50°F (10°C) for 48 hours prior to application and continuously thereafter until compound is completely dry. Drywall should be dry for at least 48 hours before the application of joint compounds. Continuous ventilation must be provided to ensure proper drying.

APPLICATION
Using the taping knife, apply joint compound to drywall, slightly beyond where the edge of the corner will be. Or use hopper to fill bead. Place corner trim on wall, ensuring it is aligned tightly to the ceiling. Press into position. Use the roller to embed the trim. Or embed using even pressure, running the knife over it at a 45° angle. Use the taping knife to skim over the edge with joint compound. Let dry thoroughly. Use the wider finishing knife to skim over the edge again. Let dry thoroughly. Lightly sand and paint.

Features:

  • High strength tapered copolymer core.
  • Severe impact resistance.
  • Corners will not separate from wall or dent.
  • Crisp sharp lines without ridges.
  • Memory-free hinge holds the desired angle and makes it easy to adjust.
  • Withstands significant shifting due to lumber drying, settling, humidity and temperature differences.
  • Surface paper is perfect for applying paint and textures.
  • GREENGUARD Gold certified.

Specifications:

  • Length - 250'
  • Package - Single Roll Carton
  • Product Standard - ASTM C1047
  • Installation Guidelines - ASTM C840/GA-216
  • Finishing Guidelines ASTM C840/GA-214
  • UL/ULC Designation NC PRO
  • Copolymer center thickness - .06" (1.5 mm)
  • Copolymer edge thickness - .02" (0.5 mm)
  • Total Flange Width - 1.875" (48 mm)
  • Copolymer Flange Width - 1.38" (35 mm)
  • Paperboard Edge Flap - .5" (13 mm)

Not only does the 15-amp motor deliver 155 CFM of airflow for maximum suction, a variable suction function allows you to manually control the level of suction and the level of power consumption based on the task at hand.

The lightweight unit—it weights only 33.5 pounds—comes fully assembled on heavy-duty wheels and locking casters for durability as it’s tugged along dirty, dusty surfaces for cleanup. A telescoping handle further improves ease of transport, and the universal hose connector and included kink-resistant hose helps reduce clogging.

A number of lift and tie-down points secure the DWV015 to scaffolding or other surfaces if necessary. With a 15-amp motor that delivers up to 155 CFM of airflow and a high-quality HEPA filter, job-site dust doesn’t stand a chance.
